test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following number series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single-digit numbers only). (Counting to be done from left to right only.)

(Left) 1 3 1 8 9 3 1 9 9 3 4 8 6 3 2 4 7 9 5 5 9 7 5 4 1 5 3 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number?
solution:
Given series: (Left) 1 3 1 8 9 3 1 9 9 3 4 8 6 3 2 4 7 9 5 5 9 7 5 4 1 5 3 (Right)

According to the question:

Required condition: Odd Number - Even Number - Even Number

(Left) 1 3 1 8 9 3 1 9 9 __**3 4 8**__ 6 __**3 2 4**__ 7 9 5 5 9 7 5 4 1 5 3 (Right)

Thus, there are two such odd numbers which are immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
